description: data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal) is an open data portal listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation, published or maintained by U.S. Department of Transportation. The U.S. Department of Transportation's open data portal lists datasets from the department's agencies on roads and bridges, public transit, rail, aviation, maritime, freight, vehicle safety and research statistics, with API and download options for each. Coverage: United States. The catalogue lists 423 datasets, each with its own page, description and export options. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network and hazard studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
licence: set per dataset on the portal
